body: For Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, existing SEO practices remain relevant. Google specifies no extra technical requirement or special AI schema, and eligibility does not guarantee inclusion. Apply this guidance only to the Google experiences it describes.

OpenAI distinguishes search discovery through OAI-SearchBot from potential training-content collection through GPTBot. Their access settings are independent. A crawler setting alone does not establish why one captured answer mentioned or omitted a brand.
